units.source_text: “你最初就是学唱《黑发》［《黑发》，是长歌之一］的吗？”

en.t: Was Kurokami the first song you learned to sing? [Translator's note: Kurokami is one of the nagauta songs.]

units.source_text: 驹子像小时候那样摇了摇头。

en.t: Komako shook her head just as she had when she was a child.

units.source_text: 打这以后，即使过夜，驹子也不再坚持在天亮之前赶回去了。

en.t: After that, even when she stayed the night, Komako no longer insisted on hurrying back before dawn.
